text:
maria: Quick async — starting a slowstart lift for feature flag `ff/predict-rl` on prod now. Plan: 1% -> 5% over ~30m, smoke, then hold for a thumbs-up before 20%. Posting checks here; callouts: rollback criteria are error-rate >0.5% OR p95 latency >800ms.

deploy-bot: deploy started for ff/predict-rl (config v12). slice=1% -> deployed to pool-a/pool-b.

aj: Copy. I'll watch latency and error-rate. Will keep rollback command ready. :eyes:

devon: Quick note — there's a gated gateway header change in the CR (PR #4820). If that lands before 5% the slice will include the new header. I'm doing the review now, should be small.

liam: Flag — I just saw a cache TTL mismatch alert in staging (kv-cache ttl=30s vs expected 300s). Pushing a config fix; might delay bump to 5% by ~10m.

maria: Hold on 5% until TTL fix is verified in staging. Can someone run a token-latency smoke after the 1% is stable? Example check:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v2","input":"hello world","max_tokens":32}' | jq '.latency'
```

deploy-bot: slice 1% confirmed healthy at 14:02:10. no errors in the last 5m.

sam: Ran the smoke above against pool-a. p50=42ms, p95=210ms, error-rate=0.00% for the sample. CPU on pool-a up 6% vs baseline. :thumbsup:

devon: CR merged (PR #4820). Gateway header will be present on next config pick. ETA config refresh ~6m.

liam: TTL fix deployed and validated in staging. KV cache now matches expected 300s. Ready for 5% from my side.

maria: Ok proceeding to 5% once aj gives the go. Reminder: if error-rate >0.5% or p95 >800ms we rollback immediately. Also watch for tail latencies and any 5xx spikes in the router.

aj: Go for 5% — bumping now. I'll monitor dashboards and keep the rollback command on-hand.

deploy-bot: slice bumped to 5% at 14:38:55. routing updated across regions.

sam: Quick scan: p50 48ms, p95 260ms, error-rate 0.03%. No obvious anomalies. Watching memory on pool-b (up ~12%).

devon: Not seeing any new errors in logs. Gateway header observed in traces for ~60% of requests (expected with config timing).

maria: Great. Keeping this thread as the runbook for the slowstart. I'll re-check in 30m. If you see anything odd ping @maria and @aj. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
